models.name: Gemma-3n-E2B-it-int4
models.description: Preview version of [Gemma 3n E2B](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma-3n) ready for deployment on Android using the [MediaPipe LLM Inference API](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/genai/llm_inference). The current checkpoint only supports text and vision input, with 4096 context length.

models.name: Gemma-3n-E4B-it-int4
models.description: Preview version of [Gemma 3n E4B](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma-3n) ready for deployment on Android using the [MediaPipe LLM Inference API](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/genai/llm_inference). The current checkpoint only supports text and vision input, with 4096 context length.

models.name: Gemma3-1B-IT q4
models.description: A variant of [google/Gemma-3-1B-IT](https://huggingface.co/google/Gemma-3-1B-IT) with 4-bit quantization ready for deployment on Android using the [MediaPipe LLM Inference API](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/genai/llm_inference)

models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct q8
models.description: A variant of [Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) with 8-bit quantization ready for deployment on Android using the [MediaPipe LLM Inference API](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/genai/llm_inference)

models.name: Phi-4-mini-instruct (4-bit)
models.description: A 4-bit quantized variant of Microsoft's Phi-4-mini model, optimized for on-device deployment.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen (4-bit)
models.description: A 4-bit quantized, distilled version of DeepSeek R1, optimized for high-performance reasoning and code generation.

models.name: Gemma3-270M-IT (4-bit)
models.description: A 4-bit quantized 270M parameter model, ideal for fine-tuning (LoRA) for specific on-device tasks.

models.name: TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat (4-bit)
models.description: A 8-bit quantized version of TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, an extremely compact, English-focused chat model.

models.name: Llama-3.2-1B-instruct (4-bit)
models.description: A 4-bit quantized version of Meta's Llama 3.2 1B instruct model, optimized for on-device performance.
